newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Finnish ferry refloated and heads to shore.
newsitem.headline: Finnish ferry refloated and heads to shore.

text.p: A Finnish ferry, Sea Wind, was refloated on Thursday morning and headed to shore after running aground a day earlier, a spokeswoman from Sweden's Board of Maritime Investigations said.

The cargo and passenger ferry, owned by SeaWind Line Oy Ab, part of Finnish passenger ferry operator Silja Oy Ab, ran aground near Mjolko in Stockholm's archipelago early on Wednesday while on route from Turku to Stockholm.
Its 107 passengers were evacuated to Stockholm.
The board's spokeswoman said the ferry, which runs about 12 tours a week, was refloated early on Thursday and was now on its way into Stockholm.
The extent of damage was not yet known.
